metadata.case_name: WONG YIN WA v. CHAN SHING

injuries.description: a 2cm U-shape cut over the dorsum of her left hand with the left 3rd proximal phalangal joint exposed
injuries.body_part: left hand (dorsum), left 3rd proximal phalangal joint
source: a 2cm U-shape cut over the dorsum of her left hand with the left 3rd proximal phalangal joint exposed
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of finger or thumb

injuries.description: a complete cut of the left middle finger extensor tendon
source: a complete cut of the left middle finger extensor tendon
injuries.icd_description: Laceration of extensor muscle, fascia or tendon of other finger at wrist or hand level

injuries.description: the detachment of cartilage of the left third metacarpal head
source: the detachment of cartilage of the left third metacarpal head
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the wrist or hand

injuries.description: a portion of the articular surface of the 3rd metacarpal head was removed resulting in incongruity of the third metacarpal-phalangeal joint
injuries.body_part: left third metacarpal-phalangeal joint (portion of articular surface removed)
source: the x-ray film showed that a portion of the articular surface of the 3rd metacarpal head was also removed because the fracture involving the articular surface was not amenable to fixation and the fracture fragment bearing the articular cartilage has to be removed together with the cartilage.

This resulted in incongruity of the third metacarpal-phalangeal joint; which accounted for the residual pain the plaintiff experienced when she flexed her left palm, the stiffness of her left middle finger and reduction of her left hand grip power.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of other specified part of other metacarpal bone

manifestations.description: residual pain the plaintiff experienced when she flexed her left palm
stiffness of her left middle finger
reduction of her left hand grip power
hand grip power of the plaintiff measured as a 53% loss of left hand grip relative to her right hand
assessed to have suffered 12% of impairment of the whole person
difficulty in coping with her household chores as she found it hard to exert force with her left hand
she was unable to use her left hand to assist in carrying heavy items
a high chance of developing symptomatic post-traumatic osteoarthritis on her left third metacarpal-phalangeal joint

treatments_received: tendon repair operation under general anaesthesia
cartilage on her 3rd knuckle joint removed
3 sessions of out-patient treatments between June and August 1999
12 sessions of physiotherapy treatment between June 1999 and July 2000
12 sessions of occupational therapy treatment between June 1999 and July 2000
brief physical examination by Dr. Lee Po-chin (December 1999)
treatments_future: fusion operation of the metacarpal-phalangeal joint when significant pain develops (to trade pain for a stiff knuckle)
convalescent and rehabilitation period of 3 months following fusion operation

losses.description: Tendon, cartilage and a portion of the articular surface of her left middle finger cut leading to incongruity of the metacarpal-phalangeal joint, stiffness and reduced grip

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Difficulty in coping with household chores because she found it hard to exert force with her left hand
